topics.label: Introduction to cancer hallmarks and progression models
topics.groupedBecause: This opening section outlines the lecture's learning objectives and introduces the multi-step mutation progression and framework of cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Growth signaling pathways and oncogenic mutations
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how mutations in signaling cascades such as Wnt/beta-catenin and receptor tyrosine kinase pathways drive sustained proliferation and cell survival.

topics.label: Block in terminal differentiation in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how differentiation arrest contributes to tumor development in both hematopoietic malignancies and colorectal carcinoma.

topics.label: Evasion of apoptosis and p53 regulation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes the mechanisms by which cancer cells avoid programmed cell death through alterations in p53, Bax, and BCL2 signaling.

topics.label: Replicative immortality, senescence, and cellular stress responses
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics cover telomere biology, TERT activation mechanisms, p53-dependent senescence and stress signaling, and summarize the growth-control hallmarks of cancer.

topics.label: Altered cellular metabolism and oncometabolites
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss metabolic reprogramming in cancer, including the Warburg effect, tissue-specific profiles, and the role of Krebs cycle mutations and oncometabolites in tumorigenesis.

topics.label: Tumor angiogenesis and vascular recruitment
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic addresses the induction of angiogenesis as an essential requirement for tumor growth, perfusion, and progression beyond microscopic sizes.

topics.label: Metastasis, systemic dissemination, and metastatic genetics
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the sequential steps of metastatic spread, the seed and soil hypothesis, circulating tumor cells, and the genomic features of secondary metastases.

topics.label: Lecture summary and recommended reading
topics.groupedBecause: This closing section summarises the key takeaways regarding cancer hallmarks and points students toward further reading and practical exercises.
